title: A dataset recorded during development of an affective brain-computer music interface: testing session
description: EEG recordings from 8 healthy adults using a real-time, online affective music brain-computer interface. The system identified each listener's emotional state and modified synthetically generated 60 s music clips on the fly to induce target affective states defined by valence and arousal. The dataset includes self-reported valence and arousal and is one of three connected datasets from the BCMI-MIdAS project.
methods_description: Participants listened to 60 s synthetic music clips while EEG was recorded at 1 kHz. The first 20 s targeted one affective state (A). In the remaining 40 s the BCMI estimated the participant's current affective state and generated music to move them toward a second target state (B). Participants reported valence and arousal.
